name: MEV bot 0xDd7c2987 forged CREATE2 pair callback

classification.summary: The bot authenticated its swap callback by checking the caller against a CREATE2 address derived from a factory address, token pair and init-code hash all supplied in the call data, so the attacker deployed a contract at a matching derived address and used the callback to move the operator's WETH, USDT and USDC allowances to themselves.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
